title: [review] lichen-node forwarder drops DAOs carrying generalized Targets (wave-6 wire-profile widening broke multi-hop)
description: P1, wave-6 review. message.rs:481 now admits generalized Target bodies, but lichen-node/src/routing/router.rs:1148 dao_parents_for_source parses each target with RplTarget::from_bytes which still requires exactly 18 bytes + prefix_len==128 + flags==0 (message.rs:706-720), and ok()? aborts the whole function on the first non-conforming option; node.rs:597-601 treats None as drop-not-forward. Net: the legitimate grouped DAO (self-/128 + delegated-/64) proven by the new end-to-end test is silently dropped at the first non-root hop - delegated prefixes only propagate when the advertiser is adjacent to the root. Fails closed, no security exposure, but breaks the feature's multi-hop story. Fix: teach dao_parents_for_source the 8.7.1 generalized body shape (or skip-and-continue per-option instead of aborting) + multi-hop forwarding test with a delegated-/64 DAO. Note: cargo test -p lichen-node currently blocked by unrelated concurrent in-flight lichen-oscore work.
